dispositions.reason: Host FileReferenceService is a replaceable Cordis service seam; Session Controller exposes its list through fileReferences Remote to Web.
Published local provider and reusable WorkspaceFileSearch implementation; provider is replaceable and search utility can be used by another provider, with Agent-scoped cleanup.
Host resolver publishes generated candidates Remote to Client assembly; prepare remains Host-only durable untrusted context path.

WorkspaceRegistry is public Host durable entity service; workspace/session-activity and workspace/session-stop are composition events. Browser uses UiWorkspace or Workspace Controller, not direct registry.

Host ctx.workspaceChanges summary/diff is a public typed service tied to workspace/changes event sequence; no direct Client Remote is exported. Built-in deliverables supplies its own presentation path.
